notes_for_editor: Record point 36.42388, -80.66 agrees with the NGS position (36 25 25.85 N, 080 39 36.08 W) to within a few metres; no correction proposed. The 1954 description and the last recovery note (1987) are the only evidence that the tower stood; no source found says whether it stands now. Dobson Township article (1,275 ft) and TopoQuest (1,587 ft) disagree on the summit height; the story reports both. The tnlandforms list was compiled from the NC FFLA site, topo maps and NGS datasheets, and warns it may include observation towers. Two web searches found no lookout-tower reference after 1987. Human check: whether the 1954 tower still stands and whether the site is open.
